The '''Rimma Trade Route''' was one of the major routes that crossed the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. It started at [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], and went all the way to the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] in the far reaches of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

An important branch of the Rimma, the [[Shapani Bypass/Legends|Shapani Bypass]], grew increasingly important in later years, and some considered it part of the Rimma for all practical purposes.

Another branch, which was a continuation of the Rimma, was the [[Trition Trade Route]]. The Trition began at [[Karideph]] and continued on into the Kathol sector.<ref name="tdc">''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]''</ref>

==History==
[[File:Rimma_Trade_Route_Map.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Akaavi Spar]] looking at the map of the Rimma Trade Route]]
When the [[Herglic Trade Empire]] joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[13,000 BBY]], the [[Hidakai Pool]] begun to develop. From there, [[Herglic/Legends|Herglics]] and [[Givin/Legends|Givin]] theorists knit together the Rimma; [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] merchants who came to [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] and having innate navigational talents, found ready jobs as scouts, pilots and [[hyperspace mapper]]s and established the Route [[5500 BBY/Legends|5500 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Rimma Trade Route was [[Blockade of the Rimma Trade Route|seized]] by the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] as part of their initial infiltration of Republic space in [[3681 BBY]]. Consequently, it was economically strangled by imperial sanctions for a year before the blockade was broken by the Republic, though remained contested for much of the war.<ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref>

Commerce along the Route enriched [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], the Tapani sector and colonization of the south.<ref name="TEA" />

In the years before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] had a de-facto monopoly on the Rimma Trade Route. Subsequently, the planets on the route were the main recruitment grounds for the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]].
